harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: The conditional clause, the answer to the vocative, is resumptive; the preposition phrase «لعدَّتهن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «هنَّ» in «طلِّقوهن». The clause «واتقوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أحصوا»; «ربكم» is a badal (substitute) from the Divine Name; the clause «لا تخرجوهنَّ» is resumptive. The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يأتين» is excepted from the generality of states, i.e.: they are not to go out in any state except the state of their committing an indecency; the conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «لا تدري» is resumptive; the clause «لعل الله يحدث» stands in place of the two objects of (درى), «لعل» being among the suspending [particles] (al-muʿalliqāt).

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding conditional clause {إِذَا طَلَّقْتُمُ}; the preposition phrase «بمعروف» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «أمسكوهنَّ»; «ذوي» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) with the yāʾ because it is dual; the preposition phrase «منكم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «ذوي عدل»; «من» is a relative noun, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the preposition phrase «له» is attached to the second object of «جعل».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «حيث» is an adverbial noun in the position of a genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يرزقه», and the clause «يحتسب» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause «ومن يتوكل» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «من يتق»; the clause «قد جعل» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «لكل شيء» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «قدرا».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The clause «واللائي يئسن..» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «من نسائكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the nūn in «يئسن»; the clause «إن ارتبتم فعدَّتهن ثلاثة» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «اللائي», and the clause «فعدَّتهن ثلاثة» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of «إن». His words «واللائي لم يحضن»: a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «اللائي يئسن»; his words «وأولات»: a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the nominal clause «أجلهن أن يضعن»; the preposition phrase «له» is attached to the second object of «يجعل»; the preposition phrase «من أمره» is attached to a ḥāl from «يسرا».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «أنزله» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أمر الله»; the conditional clause is resumptive; the preposition phrase «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «يعظم».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The preposition phrase «من وجدكم» is a badal (substitute) from «من حيث»; the clause «وإن كن» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أسكنوهن»; «أولات» is the khabar (predicate) of kāna, accusative (manṣūb) with the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural; the clause «فإن أرضعن» is conjoined to the clause «إن كن»; the clause «وأتمروا» is conjoined to the clause «فآتوهن»; the preposition phrase «بمعروف» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «وأتمروا»; and the clause «وإن تعاسرتم» is conjoined to the clause «إن أرضعن».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The lām in «لينفق» is the lām of command, governing the jussive; the conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ينفق»; the preposition phrase «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ينفق»; the clause «لا يكلف الله» is resumptive; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); «ما» is a relative noun, second object; the clause «سيجعل» is resumptive; «بعد» is an adverb attached to the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The wāw is resumptive; «كأين» is a noun alluding to a number (ism kināya), a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition phrase «من قرية» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كأين»; the clause «عتت» is the khabar (predicate) of «كأين»; the clause «فحاسبناها» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «عتت»; «حسابا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «فذاقت» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {عَذَّبْنَاهَا}, and the clause «وكان» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «فاتقوا» is resumptive; «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective); the clause «قد أنزل» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: «رسولا» is a badal (substitute); the clause «يتلو» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رسول»; «مبينات» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «آيات الله»; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليخرج» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يتلو»; the conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «قد أحسن» is a ḥāl clause from the hāʾ in «يدخله».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: «الله الذي» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the preposition phrase «من الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مثلهن»; «مثلهن» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «سبع»; the clause «يتنزل» is a naʿt (adjective) of «سبع سماوات»; the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «لتعلموا» is attached to «خلق»; the interpreted maṣdar «أن الله على..» stands in place of the two objects of «علم», and the second maṣdar is conjoined to the first; the preposition phrase «بكل» is attached to «أحاط»; «علما» is tamyīz (specification).
